title: Installing Claude Code
content: To feel more intertwined with your favorite code editor, Claude code can be installed. Desktop installation allows Claude to run in the background while other tasks are performed. Claude code on the web is suitable for remote work on projects through GitHub repositories or for parallel sessions. Installation choice is up to the user.
